pairing._comment: Single source of truth for the hmz official/rlar pairing rendered by scripts/hmz-run.sh. Owner directive 2026-09-29: worker codex/gpt-6.1-sol at effort=max, reviewer claude/claude-opus-5-5 at effort=max (replaced 2026-09-21's codex/gpt-6-astra:medium + claude/claude-opus-5:max). credentials=omp:anthropic: hmz-run.sh injects ANTHROPIC_* from the OMP 'anthropic' credential (~/.omp/agent/agent.db) for the claude reviewer; the codex worker authenticates from ~/.codex/auth.json. hmz upstream renamed humanize2 -> humanize (installed 2026-09-21 from git+https://github.com/humanfia/humanize.git) and rewrote the exec -a spec grammar to <cli>/<model>:<effort>; specs carry cli/model/effort only — permission/web_search live in the flow declaration. Constraint: worker and reviewer models must be distinct.

acceptance: Exit status alone is not acceptance. Require the actual reviewer done:true and terminal ended how:done; separately check mathematical scope and Lean evidence.
